items.title: 67559_Art Hodes oral history interview
items.q: he came with this girl singer and I think at that time it was Helen Forrest.

ctx.x: I followed Jess through numerous jobs. He's been very kind to me. And then one day I got a call that Benny Goodman was coming down to work, I was playing, I was playing with Rod Cless, someplace in Chicago, 5100 Club or something, 5100 North Broadway. And Baby Frank Snyder was playing drums.

Everybody got very excited, and I said, what's all the excitement about? Benny Goodman. So, who's Benny Goodman? He's got a big band. I wasn't interested. I was interested in small bands, even then. He came with John Hammond and he came with this girl singer and I think at that time it was Helen Forrest.
